attributes.background: To whom this may concern. I am proposing to make a bid to host the FIFA World Cup 2038. We have enough stadiums with a capacity more than the required amount or room to expand such as Wembley, Emirates, Annfield, Ethiad, Old Trafford, Elland Road, Hillsborough, London Stadium, Villa Park, St James

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about whether to bid to host international sporting events are matter for the relevant sporting body - in this case the Football Association - not the UK Government or Parliament.
